newsitem.title: USA: BDM International says awaded FDA contract.
newsitem.headline: BDM International says awaded FDA contract.

text.p: BDM International Inc said Thursday it has been awarded a contract potentially worth $100 million to provide information systems support to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
The company said the seven-year contract comes under the Strategic Technical Integration Resources program.
The company said its team members on the contract are Andersen Consulting, IDC, JIL Information Systems, Mindbank, ROW Sciences, Stellar Business Services, and Vistronix.
